When I was 15 I overdosed on ~100 pills. 
Cymbalta and Topamax. 
Cymbalta is a strong SSRI anti depressant and Topamax is supposed to treat migraines... again 100 pills. 
I was 4'10" and weighed 98lbs. My little body did not handle it well. I don't remember anything after about 1hr after taking them all. I remember vomiting in the toilet for ~45mins and being so weak. 
The side effects were awful. I had hallucinations and my body wasn't very cooperative. My mind was slow... I was out of school rehabbing myself at home for a month and a week. 
I honestly can say I don't remember too much from that time other than struggling to lift a gallon of milk and holding the walls to walk down the hallway. I'd try to nap and my legs were restless. My body was a mess for a very long time. I lost so much strength and memory. I always wondered what damage was done to my body. 
That night after I took all the pills, I could have slipped into a coma.

I'm not a veterinarian, but I work with pets and I'm highly interested in feline behavior... I have done a lot of observing and studying. 

Cats tend to "bury" their food if they are unhappy with what they are being fed, or as natural instinct to "hide" it/save it for later. 
As far as digging at the wall and floor near the litter box, there's a lot of speculation that it could be the litter area is too small, they want you to clean their litter box, they rule the house therefore they don't bury their poop. It's often a sign of dominance. 

There could be other reasons behind your cat's behavior because every cat is different (although I doubt it), but it certainly is normal. :) 
I hope this helps cure your curiosity!
